task.title: Add batch outreach and trainable instructions to Renzo
task.description:
ADD two features to existing Renzo. Surgical edits only:

1. BATCH OUTREACH NAV: Add 'Batch Outreach' button to sidebar nav (data-view='batch'). Add a batch view div (id='view-batch') with: a textarea for natural language prompt, a Generate Batch button, a progress indicator div, results list. Add JS function executeBatchOutreach(query): filters contacts by keywords in query (contract/expiry->contractExpiry field, invoice->invoiceAmount, contacted->lastContactDate), generates AI message for each match using existing generateAiMessage(), adds to queue, shows progress.

2. TRAINABLE RULES in Settings: Add a 'My Outreach Rules' section to the existing settings view with: textarea for new rule, Add Rule button, list of rules with delete buttons. Store rules in localStorage key 'renzo_rules'. Modify AI prompt generation to append rules: 'Additional instructions: [rule1]. [rule2].' Add JS functions: addOutreachRule(), deleteOutreachRule(), loadRules(), renderRules().

issues: Duplicate function definitions: handleCSVFile, parseCSV, and showCSVPreview are each defined twice with incompatible implementations. The second definitions will silently overwrite the first, breaking CSV import functionality.

Truncated/incomplete code: CSS rules are incomplete (missing closing braces), code ends mid-function ('event.target.fi', 'renderRules' cuts off at '<div s'), and createCSVPreviewModal HTML string is incomplete. This will cause syntax errors and broken features.

CSV parsing will fail on real-world data: Using simple split(',') breaks on quoted fields with commas (e.g., 'Company, Inc.' will split incorrectly). Missing null/undefined checks will cause runtime errors.
data.feedback:
CRITICAL FIXES REQUIRED:

1. **Remove duplicate functions** - You have handleCSVFile(), parseCSV(), and showCSVPreview() defined twice each. Delete the first definitions and keep only the second (more complete) versions.

2. **Complete the truncated code** - The file ends abruptly mid-function. Finish the renderRules() function, complete the createCSVPreviewModal() HTML string with proper closing tags, and fix the incomplete CSS rules (add missing closing braces for '.batch-matches-preview h' and complete the media query).

3. **Fix CSV parsing** - Replace the naive split(',') with proper CSV parsing that handles quoted fields: `line.match(/(?:^|,)("(?:[^"]|"")*"|[^,]*)/g).map(field => field.replace(/^,/, '').replace(/^"|"$/g, '').replace(/""/g, '"'))`

4. **Add null checks** - In parseCSV(), check if text is null/undefined before processing.

5. **Define missing functions** - Add detectField() and generateAiMessage() functions that are called but never defined.

The app cannot function with duplicate function definitions overwriting each other and truncated code causing syntax errors.

blocking_issues: Modal display property conflict: `.modal` has `display: none` but `.modal.active` sets `display: flex`. This will cause opacity transition to not work properly since display changes can't be transitioned. Use `visibility: hidden` instead or remove opacity transition.
Mobile insights-grid declaration is incomplete: `grid-` line is cut off at line 768, causing CSS to break on mobile devices.
Search input background SVG is not URL-encoded properly: Single quotes in stroke color `%234b5563` may break in some browsers. Should be properly escaped.
Modal accessibility critical issues: No focus trap, no keyboard navigation support (ESC key), no aria-labels or role attributes for screen readers.
Color contrast likely fails WCAG AA: `.contact-card-subtitle` and `.contact-card-meta` use `--text-secondary` which needs verification against white background for 4.5:1 ratio.
Interactive cards without keyboard support: `.contact-card` has `cursor: pointer` but no visual focus state or keyboard handler indication.
Loading spinner lacks accessibility: No aria-live region or screen reader text to announce loading state.
Duplicate function definitions: handleCSVFile and parseCSV are defined twice, causing conflicts
Incomplete CSS rule at line 768 - `.header-actions` width property cuts off mid-declaration (likely missing 'flex-start' or similar)
Modal uses `visibility` + `opacity` but should handle focus trapping for keyboard navigation - no indication of aria-modal or role attributes being styled
Interactive elements (.contact-card) use only hover states without focus-visible states - keyboard users cannot see focus
Color contrast may fail WCAG AA: --text-secondary on white backgrounds, --gold on --gold-light, alert text colors need verification
Search input background SVG uses hardcoded color (#4b5563) that won't respect high contrast modes or theme changes
Loading spinner animation has no prefers-reduced-motion alternative - accessibility violation
Modal animation has no prefers-reduced-motion query - could trigger vestibular issues
CSV parsing doesn't handle quoted commas properly - will break on 'Company, Inc' or names with commas
